# APIs.io Terms of Service

> What each provider's API terms permit and prohibit: caching, redistribution, attribution, governing law, liability and notice periods. Every statement is quoted word for word from the provider's own page, with the page and the date it was read. Nothing is generated, and APIs.io verifies none of it.

- [Terms of Service directory](https://apis.io/api-terms/): every published document
- [API Commons Terms of Service schema](https://github.com/api-commons/terms-of-service): the format these documents use
- [ODRL](https://www.w3.org/TR/odrl-model/): the W3C Open Digital Rights Language, whose permission / prohibition / duty model the stances follow
